sentence_2_it: Tom lavora part-time come autista di limousine.
sentence_2_en: Tom works part-time as a limousine driver.
sentence_3_it: Quando il bus sbandò per evitare un gatto, l'autista disse, C'è mancato poco!
sentence_3_en: When the bus swerved to miss a cat, the driver said, That was a close one!

sentence_1_it: Oggi gli autisti degli autobus fanno sciopero.
sentence_1_en: Today the bus drivers are striking.
